_purpose: Canonical answers for integration-vendor developer-portal forms. Every registration (agent-driven or human) fills from THIS file so answers never drift. Keep factual — vendor reviewers verify URLs.
app_description_short: Analytics and forecasting for restaurants: sales, menu, inventory and labor insights computed from the merchant's own POS data.
app_description_long: Meridian Intelligence is a read-only analytics platform for independent restaurants and retailers. Merchants connect their point-of-sale and back-office tools; Meridian computes dashboards, demand forecasts, menu engineering and labor insights from that data. We request read-only scopes wherever the provider offers them and never write to the merchant's system of record.
data_use_statement: Data is used solely to provide analytics to the merchant who authorized the connection. No resale, no cross-merchant use, no advertising use.
scopes_justification: Read-only access to transactions/sales, catalog/menu items, inventory levels and labor summaries — the minimum needed to compute revenue analytics, forecasts and menu insights for the authorizing merchant.
logo_note: Use the Meridian 'M' mark; PNG exports live in frontend/public/. Most portals want 512x512 PNG.
company_address_note: US entity address — see /root/.secrets/asp-epc1.txt (Sheridan WY registered agent). Never paste into this file.
security_summary: OAuth tokens encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), TLS in transit, least-privilege scopes, per-merchant data isolation, access logging.
